single_supported_premise.statement: On this reported seed/budget/exposed cohort, the Macro gap between the selected full-training model and the constrained-training model remains when the full model is evaluated with lambda disabled. The observation therefore concerns which lambda-disabled predictor was reached after training and selection; it does not establish that retaining lambda at selected-model inference improves Macro.

exact_observations.scope: seed307; four epochs; train2361/1024 already-exposed validation; reported matched common initialization, orders, optimizer and budget

single_supported_premise.fact_assumptions: The reported checkpoint identities, cohort, gate definitions and comparisons are correct. They were not independently reaudited in this pass. The contrast includes the training and checkpoint-selection procedures, not only an instantaneous gradient effect.
single_supported_premise.important_language_boundary: Lambda-disabled means the named fusion term is disabled. It does not mean all complex state phases or all phase-sensitive Born features have been removed.
what_is_not_supported: That the phase component generally improves optimization or sample efficiency
That g2's causal effect is separated from gate-coordinate, radial coupling, penalty, capacity or selection effects
That the Macro increase means better conditional likelihood: CE ranks these two models in the opposite order
That equality of full on/off aggregate Macro and accuracy means identical predictions or logits
That the displayed training contrast generalizes to new examples, budgets or seeds

why_this_is_not_a_theory_route: The new control narrows the location of the discrepancy to the fitted predictors and their history; it does not specify a new task law or a nontrivial learning mechanism. The functional mixture twin is an important equivalence fact, while its nonmatched optimization coordinates and penalty prevent attributing the training difference to a unique component. Reparameterization dependence alone is known and does not supply L5 novelty. No generic phase/extra-parameter optimization hypothesis is endorsed.
missing_task_or_learning_premise: An independently specified task requirement or training-population mechanism that predicts which label decisions should improve under this policy contrast, and why the improvement should persist after the relevant competing channels are controlled. The packet's opposing Macro/CE ordering does not identify such a requirement, rare-class benefit, semantic distinction or implicit-bias law.

smallest_discriminating_observation.descriptive_record: If already retained, inspect one paired record per member of the existing 1024 cohort: gold label, full-selected lambda-disabled prediction, constrained-control prediction, and each model's true-label CE. Analyze the complete cohort rather than outcome-selected cases. A train-defined class-frequency or independently annotated task stratum may be included only if fixed before this inspection.
smallest_discriminating_observation.question_it_can_settle: Does the observed Macro/CE tradeoff consist of the specific changed decisions a proposed task premise predicts, or of other class/confidence changes? These paired fields can localize the discrepancy without another head, readout refit, seed or epoch.
smallest_discriminating_observation.question_it_cannot_settle: An exposed-cohort table cannot establish a novel optimization mechanism, phase necessity, independent generalization or an unprovided semantic premise. No exact sample size or independent confirming endpoint follows from this packet.
smallest_discriminating_observation.execution_condition: This is advice about the smallest useful observation, not a request to run a model, recover unavailable artifacts, retrain, or allocate resources. If paired records are unavailable, do not create a run merely to fill this table.

control_and_equivalence_boundaries: The reported selected constrained head matches an ordinary mixture functional twin on the whole cohort. That establishes an inference equivalence for those fitted states, not matching of optimizer coordinates, penalties or training trajectories.
Any later learning claim must specify which of those differences it targets and match the others. The current facts do not determine a new scientifically sufficient control.
An exact classical implementation is a valid equivalence/control and does not disqualify an ordinary Q-RMEA contribution. No exclusive quantum utility or speedup requirement is imposed.
Original full-data L4 is not inherited by the changed entity-conditioned fusion head or by its new fitted control.

packet_identifiers_not_reverified_here.check: Whether the proposed addition/gate geometry exceeds the known partial-swap construction.
Whether a claimed imaginarity criterion is already the known cyclic witness, and whether its task link is actually new.
Exact role of complex states, density mixtures, trainable measurements and optimization in the original CNM model.
Exact phase-aware feature construction and its real-feature counterpart in the original Q-Interference work.

original_work_to_check_before_claiming_n.additional_required_neighborhood_if_a_le: Original work on reparameterization-dependent adaptive optimization/regularization and the mismatch between log-loss and nondecomposable class metrics. No identifier, theorem transfer or novelty conclusion is asserted from memory.
original_work_to_check_before_claiming_n.novelty_status: Unverified. All listed identifiers and bounded scopes were supplied by the packet; no papers or exploration files were read here.

stop_conditions: Stop if the only new result is that two coordinates or constrained trajectories optimize differently.
Stop a task-specific explanation if it fails to predict the paired decision changes under its independently fixed stratum or rule.
Do not infer rare-class usefulness or semantic improvements merely from the aggregate Macro increase.
Do not turn the worse-CE/higher-Macro contrast into a universal benefit or replace the predeclared endpoint after seeing outcomes.
Do not request optional seeds, epoch extensions or a full owner experiment to rescue this premise. A genuinely new task-backed proposal would need separate review and evidence.

independence_and_execution.operations: Requested file reading, hashing, output creation and mechanical output verification only.
